en.headline: Three injured in Kwun Tong Bypass three-vehicle collision
en.dek: A private car struck a Citybus and another car near MegaBox on Thursday evening, briefly trapping a driver and closing the Yau Tong-bound lanes.
body: Three people were injured in a three-vehicle collision on the Kwun Tong Bypass on Thursday evening.

Police and reports said a private car travelling towards Tseung Kwan O struck a Citybus on route 798 and another private car near MegaBox around 9 pm. A female driver of one private car was briefly trapped and later freed. The injured included a woman in her 70s who was a bus passenger, a man in his 60s who was a private-car driver, and a woman in her 30s who was a passenger. All were described as having sustained minor injuries.

The Transport Department said the Yau Tong-bound lanes of the bypass near the Hong Kong Post Building were closed, with partial closures in the opposite direction, causing congestion. Citybus said the driver involved has been suspended from duty pending the police investigation.
The case remains under investigation. No serious injuries were reported.

zh.headline: 觀塘繞道三車相撞釀三人受傷
zh.dek: 周四晚上近MegaBox一輛私家車撞及城巴及另一私家車，一名司機一度被困，往油塘方向全線封閉。
body: 觀塘繞道周四晚上發生三車相撞意外，造成三人受傷。
據報道，一輛私家車沿觀塘繞道往將軍澳方向行駛，約晚上9時在MegaBox附近先後撞及一輛城巴798線及另一輛私家車。其中一輛私家車女司機一度被困，經救援後脫困。傷者包括城巴一名70多歲女乘客、一名60多歲私家車男司機及一名30多歲女乘客，均屬輕傷。
運輸署表示，往油塘方向近香港郵政大樓的全線已封閉，對向部分行車線亦封閉，現場交通繁忙。城巴表示已即時暫停涉事車長職務，並配合警方調查。
案件仍在調查中，未有嚴重傷亡報告。
